title: Switching From Morphine to Oral Methadone Plus Acetaminophen in the Treatment of Cancer Pain
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether oral methadone plus acetaminophen can substitute morphine in the treatment of cancer pain.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Clinical diagnosis of cancer pain
* Regular use of oral Morphine

Exclusion Criteria:

* Use of Acetaminophen in the last 48 hours
* Renal or Hepatic failure
